deviations.change: Reuse one ProcessPoolExecutor across immutable shards instead of recreating workers for every shard.
deviations.evidence: The first completed 64-row 8D shard required 131.05 s wall time and 955.83 s summed worker time because each new worker repeated import/JIT startup. The completed shard was independently reloadable and remains unchanged.
deviations.scientific_contract_impact: None. Parameter draws, parameter order, simulator seeds, simulator call, v8a_t13 dynamics, 14D extractor, validity rules, shard contents, and preregistered diagnostic rules are unchanged.
deviations.primary_verdict_consequence: No compromise. The preregistration artifact and its hash remain immutable; this deviation is retained in the final report.

deviations.incident: After 7,104 attempted 8D rows, long-lived workers exhausted host memory. The immutable originals contain 6,861 valid and 243 explicit failed rows; the pool then terminated with BrokenProcessPool.
deviations.recovery: Recycle the same eight workers every eight 64-row shards. Retry only failed rows with their exact original theta and simulator seed, save successful retries as immutable sidecars, and preserve all original failure shards.
deviations.audit_evidence: 111 original shards are readable, contiguous over sample IDs 0..7103, contain no duplicates or object arrays, and have no corrupt partial file. Failure reasons are retained in matched_banks/8d/recovery_audit_20260728.json.
deviations.scientific_contract_impact: None. Priors, parameter order, Sobol rows, simulator seed schedule, worker count, simulator, duration, preprocessing, 14D extractor, validity definition, and diagnostic rules are unchanged.
deviations.primary_verdict_consequence: No compromise. Retry sidecars are an auditable engineering recovery; original failures remain available and retry resolution is reported separately.
